text: {"lessons":["I held through several monthly swings without reacting, which reinforced that random short-term moves alone are not a reason to trade.","Selling part of Stock C at a gain felt rewarding, but the gain relative to my cost does not by itself show that selling was the right decision; I should judge it by my plan and portfolio risk.","My initial purchases spread money across five stocks, and I should keep evaluating the whole portfolio while avoiding trades driven by regret about losses or pleasure in realizing gains."]}
